definition: [ סָרָב ] noun masculine rebel ? according to Thes and others (probably Aramaic loan-word, compare Aramaic contradict, chatter, prattle, tell lies ; Pa`el סְרַב and Late Hebrew Pi`el סֵרֵב = Biblical Hebrew; compare סרב loving contradiction ); — plural absolute (i.e. אִתָּךְ ) סָרָבִים וְסַלּוֺנִים אוֺתָ֑ךְ Ezek 2:6 rebelles et quasi spinae sunt erga te Thes ; Vrss read participle, Co Berthol סֹרְבִים וְסֹלִים resisting and despising thee (compare סַלּוֺן ); AV RV briers and thorns compare Ew Hi - Sm Siegf Kau Da Toy.
